style.backgroundSystem: only one cool family across the set: a seamless pale gradient field #F1F0FA falling into a lilac gradient plane #C9C6EC, one translucent geometric acrylic prism block #E7EEFA with a matte riser step #BDB6E4 for the opening screen, concentric ring graphics in #C9C6EC behind the standing device, and flat rounded-corner gradient cards running #C9C6EC into #9B93D6 as the infographic panels; no wood, no marble, no plants, no sky, no outdoor scenery, no dark studio
style.direction: cool-neutral premium medical-device ecommerce, clean clinical softness for a hearing aid sold to families
style.iconSystem: solid gradient discs #9B93D6 in a row under a white card, plus thin-line circular badges with one 2px-stroke glyph each, maximum four per row or screen, indigo accent #4E6BE0 reserved for data graphics; no pictogram invented inside an empty disc, no diamond lozenge, no certificate seal
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused 5500K high-key studio key from the upper left with a broad fill card at the right, low contrast, faint cool rim highlight along one device edge, one gentle contact shadow always grounding the device, never a hard shadow, never a dramatic dark field, never a warm cast; lifestyle screens keep the same softness with window-style 4500K light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool-neutral premium medical-device ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a pale gradient field #F1F0FA, a lilac gradient card and platform plane #C9C6EC, a clean panel #FFFFFF, deep periwinkle headline ink #7A73B8, dark charcoal label ink #2D2D2D and one indigo data accent #4E6BE0; cool tone held throughout; soft diffused 5500K high-key key light from the upper left with a broad fill card at the right, low contrast, a faint rim highlight along one device edge and one gentle contact shadow that always grounds the product, never a warm cast and never a dark dramatic field; backgrounds limited to the seamless pale gradient field #F1F0FA into #C9C6EC, one translucent acrylic prism block #E7EEFA on a matte riser #BDB6E4, concentric ring graphics in #C9C6EC and flat rounded-corner gradient cards running #C9C6EC into #9B93D6, no wood, no marble, no plants, no dark studio; surfaces matte pale lilac #F1F0FA with glossy acrylic risers #E7EEFA and one clean panel #FFFFFF; one modern geometric sans-serif only, two-line headline placeholders at 32-44pt in #7A73B8 or #FFFFFF, one 16pt sub-line, 12-14pt labels in #2D2D2D, Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, one thin crossed-x glyph at every section-title corner; icon system of solid gradient discs #9B93D6 and thin-line circular badges with one 2px-stroke glyph each, maximum four per row, indigo #4E6BE0 only for data graphics; stable single-device scale with the device always shown as one slim curved body with a thin transparent ear-hook and narrow tube at a slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side profile, never duplicated outside the four-card grid, never floating without a contact shadow, never worn with a visible face; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR code, no membership badge, no dense body text, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no warm wood, plant or outdoor scenery
no dark or black studio backdrop

style.presentationRules: the device is always one slim curved body with its thin transparent ear-hook and narrow tube, shown at a slight 3/4 or a clean 90-degree side profile at constant scale, hook and tube fully inside the crop, hooking direction consistent across the set; never duplicated inside one screen except inside the deliberate four-card grid, never floating without a contact shadow, never worn with the face visible
